workflow: Image edits with native transparent backgrounds; opaque background extraction.

extraction_prompts.hand-top: Extract ONLY the long dark gray-green hand and bare wrist pointing DOWN from the TOP of this screenshot. Preserve the EXACT flat cel-shaded artwork, long thin pointing index finger, proportions, silhouette and very muted colors. Remove every background element, banner, chest, text and icons. Reconstruct the section hidden by the banner using the visible hand as reference. Rotate 180 degrees so the wrist enters from BOTTOM CENTER and index points UP, tip at 8 percent height, forearm cut at bottom. Native transparent RGBA background. No redesign, no realistic texture, no new details.
extraction_prompts.closed: Extract the EXACT CLOSED green vine-covered treasure chest from this screenshot into a native transparent RGBA image. Asset extraction, NOT redesign. Preserve its precise silhouette, three-quarter perspective, vines, dark-green flat cel shading and curved lid. Remove the white selection outline, mouse cursors, floor, black background, all text, video controls and every UI overlay. Restore the original dark edge underneath the white outline. Keep chest at the SAME position and SAME scale in the same composition as the input crop; no zoom or recenter. Native transparent background. Do not invent details, brass, locks or highlights.
extraction_prompts.grip: Create the CLOSED GRASP animation frame of this exact extracted game hand sprite. Keep canvas, wrist and forearm position, sleeve, palette, linework, flat low-detail cel shading and silhouette outside the fingers IDENTICAL. Only curl the fingers inward toward the thumb into a closed grasp around a small invisible relic. Do not include any relic/object. Preserve the specific anatomy of this sprite, including claw geometry if it is the clawed hand. The forearm still enters from bottom and the hand points up. This is the next animation pose of the SAME asset, not a redesign. Native transparent RGBA background.
extraction_prompts.background: Extract and reconstruct ONLY the scene background from this screenshot. Retain the exact black void and the dim moss-green oval patch of uneven stone floor with roots under the treasure chest. Remove the chest entirely and seamlessly fill its former footprint with the same subdued stone floor. Remove all UI, text, icons, mouse pointers, face camera, video overlays, arrows and cards. The scene is almost entirely PURE BLACK with just an isolated dim olive-green oval ground patch in the LOWER part, fading into black. Do NOT add a room, pillars, lights, architecture, fog or any new artistic detail. Preserve the screenshot's exact flat cel-painted style, dark colors and ground position. Opaque background.
extraction_prompts.hand-left: Extract ONLY the large angular olive-gold armored/clawed hand and forearm reaching from the LEFT in this screenshot. Preserve EXACT flat polygonal cel-shaded artwork, simple shapes, broad forearm cuff, claw-like fingers and open grasping pose. Remove the relic icons and glow, chest, black background and any overlays. Restore small occluded portions using the same reference design. Rotate the extracted sprite so the FOREARM ENTERS FROM BOTTOM CENTER and fingers point UP, tip at 8 percent canvas height, sleeve cut at bottom edge. Do NOT redesign, add realistic texture, extra fingers or embellishments. Native transparent RGBA background, no checkerboard. Preserve original very muted olive-gold colors.
extraction_prompts.hand-right: Extract ONLY the gray-green pointing hand with white/gray cloth wrist wraps and dark brown sleeve reaching from the RIGHT in this screenshot. Preserve EXACT flat cel-shaded artwork, colors, proportions and pointing index finger. Remove background, chest, relics, glow and overlays. Reconstruct missing fingertips only if occluded. Rotate the sprite so forearm enters from BOTTOM CENTER and index points UP, tip at 8 percent height, sleeve reaches bottom edge. Native transparent RGBA background. No redesign, textures, highlights or invented accessories.
extraction_prompts.banner: Extract only the EXACT tan parchment ribbon banner in this screenshot. Remove its text so the center is blank, restoring the same tan parchment. Preserve the precise curled ends, silhouette, folds, dark simple outlines and flat cel shading. Remove all surrounding background and other objects. This is direct asset extraction, not redesign. Center the banner horizontally on native transparent RGBA background, wide banner with generous margins, no extra shadows, no checkerboard.
extraction_prompts.open: Extract the EXACT open green vine-covered treasure chest from this screenshot into a native transparent RGBA image. This is asset extraction, NOT redesign or a new illustration. Preserve the precise silhouette, off-center three-quarter perspective, cracked dark green panels, roots and vines, flat low-detail cel shading, very dark forest-green colors, and lid shape from the reference. Remove EVERYTHING else: black background, floor, HUD, face-camera, relic icons, mouse cursors, text, arrows, video overlays. Reconstruct only tiny portions occluded by cursor overlays. Keep the chest at the SAME position and SAME scale in the same composition as the input crop, with the SAME canvas framing; no recentering or zooming. The open lid and base must be unchanged. Native transparent background, no checkerboard, no shadow added, no ground.
extraction_prompts.hand-bottom: Extract ONLY the gray-green humanoid hand and ochre/gold forearm sleeve reaching upward in this screenshot. Preserve the EXACT visible flat cel-shaded artwork, colors, polygonal shapes, finger proportions and open grasping pose. Remove the blue triangular relic, tooltip box, white text, background chest and every other object. Reconstruct the fingers where the tooltip occluded them. One hand and forearm only, wrist at lower center and fingers pointing straight up, forearm continues to the bottom edge. Keep the full visible sleeve. Do NOT redesign into realistic, detailed or painterly art. Center it on a tall canvas; hand tip near 8 percent from the top and forearm extends to bottom. Native transparent RGBA background, no checkerboard, no glow or shadow.
extraction_prompts.coin: Extract one of the small round gold coins from this screenshot as a clean reusable game sprite. Match the EXACT simple flat ochre-yellow coin design with dark outline and inset circular rim seen floating above the chest. One coin only, front face circular, center it on a native transparent RGBA canvas with generous margins. Remove all other objects, glow, background, hands, chest and text. No redesign, engraving, currency symbols, realistic reflections or added detail. Keep the source's flat cel-shaded art.
extraction_prompts.opening: Extract ONLY the treasure chest from image 1, preserving EXACTLY the lid's CURRENT angle/pose in that animation frame. Image 2 is the same chest cleanly extracted in the final fully open pose: use it ONLY to restore portions obscured by the play triangle, coins, flash rays and overlays. Do NOT copy image 2's fully-open lid angle: retain image 1's exact current partially open pose. Remove floor, UI, hands, banner, gold coins, rays, relics, video overlays, text, black background. Preserve exact dark green cel-shaded reference design, cracks, vines, three-quarter perspective, and its same position/scale/framing on the canvas as image 1. Native transparent RGBA, no redesign, no new details. This output is an intermediate animation frame.

Image 3 is a hand extracted from the reference treasure animation: use its orientation, readable flat cel shading, framing and simple gesture style ONLY. Do not copy its skin/sleeve colors onto this character.
Use the original gray armored gauntlet, dark wrist wrapping and gold armor accents visible on Ironclad; do not invent bare tan skin or red bracers.
Exactly TWO isolated sprites side by side in equal 768-pixel-wide panels on a 1536x1024 canvas. LEFT PANEL: reaching/pointing pose, fingers open to pick a relic. RIGHT PANEL: same hand closes into a grasp around an invisible small relic. Same wrist/forearm position, same scale, same pose anchor in both panels. Forearm enters from bottom of each panel; fingers point UP. Tip at about 10 percent panel height, wrist around 40 percent, long forearm cut by bottom edge. Center each arm on its panel centerline. Leave wide transparent margins separating sprites, no overlap. Back of hand faces viewer. No item held. Only hand and forearm, no full character. No text, labels, boxes, shadows or backdrop. Keep the clean low-detail flat shaded style of the extracted hand while matching our character design. Native transparent RGBA background with actual alpha, no checkerboard. This is production art for all eight roster characters, never substitute a generic hand.
